description: American International Group, Inc. is a leading global insurance organization that provides insurance solutions helping businesses and individuals in over 200 countries and jurisdictions protect their assets and manage risks, through AIG operations, licenses and authorizations as well as network partners. It executes world-class underwriting and claims expertise through franchises that are among the leaders in their geographies and segments, serves millions of clients ranging from individuals to small and medium-sized businesses to multi-national Fortune 500 companies, and has broad and long-standing distribution relationships with brokers, agents, advisors and marketplaces. It has a global workforce of more than 22,000 colleagues and approximately $41 billion in shareholders equity.
